column7: GCPSecretManagerConnector's real client() path inherited Google's SDK default of an effectively unbounded gRPC receive cap (grpc.MaxCallRecvMsgSize(math.MaxInt32)), unlike the AWS/Azure connectors' already-capped HTTP transport; found while ruling out a message-size cause for FuzzGCPSMConnectorResponse's CI OOM (the actual cause was a harness per-iteration leak, see docs/findings/2026-09-23-FINDING-gcpsm-fuzz-memory-and-recv-cap.md §1), fixed by appending an explicit grpc.MaxCallRecvMsgSize(1 MiB) dial default after Google's own; red/green-proved against the real grpc-go mechanism (bufconn + insecure creds), since option.WithGRPCConn bypasses dial-option processing entirely and ADC is unavailable in this environment; see §2 of the same finding doc
